GENERIC ELECTIVE COURSE - GE (GE-2) EDUCATION IN MULTICULTRUAL SOCIETY
Credit distribution, Eligibility and Prerequisites of the Course
Course title &
Credit distribution of the course
Lecture Tutorial Practical/
Eligibility criteria
Pre-requisite of the course
No Pre-requisite
Learning Objectives
The Learning Objectives of this course are as follows:
To understand multiculturalism and its relevance for educational settings.
To identify and analyze the cultural diversity within educational contexts, including language, religion, socioeconomic status, and gender.
To understand the theoretical foundations and historical development of multicultural education.
To evaluate the impact of cultural biases and stereotypes on teaching and learning.
To examine the challenges and possibilities of multicultural education in specific regional or national contexts.
Learning Outcomes
After completion of the course students will be able to:
Analyse with awareness and sensitivity different cultures and show an appreciation for cultural differences and inclusion of diverse individuals and communities in educational settings.
Evaluate biases and stereotypes that could become barriers in educational settings.
